name: SnapWOrder
author: dynamomx

sections.description:
SnapWOrder adds a product thumbnail column to your WooCommerce orders list so you can instantly identify what was purchased without opening each order individually.

Features:

  • Product thumbnail displayed directly in the WooCommerce orders list
  • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
  • Compatible with standard WooCommerce order storage
  • Lightweight — no external dependencies

Pro version:

A Pro version with additional features is available separately at https://dynamo.mx/snapworder

Pro features include:
* Adjustable thumbnail size
* Hover tooltip showing all items in the order with quantities
* Product count badge
* Custom badge color
* Column position control
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Product thumbnails will appear automatically in your WooCommerce orders list
  4. Go to WooCommerce > SnapWOrder to see the plugin status
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 6.0 or higher is required.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. SnapWOrder is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and with the legacy CPT-based order storage.

Where is the Pro version?

The Pro version is a separate plugin available at https://dynamo.mx/snapworder
